exposure: Mothers with previous ectopic pregnancies (medically treated vs. surgically treated)
cohort: 243,682 mothers, including 1424 with a history of ectopic pregnancy
finding: Maternal history of ectopic pregnancy is independently associated with preterm delivery, but not with long-term neurological morbidity in offspring.
mod_finding: Maternal history of surgically treated ectopic pregnancy was independently associated with cesarean delivery.
